dedupe_keys.name: replication package techno economic assessment of cement ccs under high grid carbon intensity a scenario analysis of the two eu innovation fund projects in poland and bulgaria

description: Adam Dominiak and Artur Rusowicz publish a Python replication package for cement carbon-capture projects in Poland and Bulgaria. Zenodo lists a public archive and short README under CC BY 4.0. Six scripts calculate capture-performance thresholds, avoided cost, dynamic cash-flow criteria, marginal breakeven, Monte Carlo uncertainty and attribution, using input data with a 30 June 2026 cutoff. The model can test how electricity-grid carbon intensity and policy assumptions affect cement CCS investment scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these two project cases. Coverage is the named Polish and Bulgarian projects and the authors’ capture configurations, not all EU cement works. A limitation is that the manuscript is described as submitted, and cost, grid and policy trajectories can change. The public README reports values but those are source claims. The archive was not downloaded, scripts were not run and neither emissions nor cost results were independently recalculated.
